warnings: Axes: x = numbered grids 1-5 (3.00/3.00/3.00/3.50 = 12.50); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom ฉ, จ, ง, ค, ข, ก (4.00/2.00/3.00/2.50/2.50 = 14.00). Origin = top-left main grid ฉ1, same convention as house 53 (§0.8 keeps the drawing's Thai letters).
The plan is L-shaped: bays 1-4 for rows ฉ-ข, plus bay 4-5 for rows ค-ก.
Low-resolution 2003 scan (page image 1667x1250 class); every value here was read from printed text — none scaled.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget) — x/y hold the S-sheet ticks only.
